summary: A hiker fell on a steep, undefined local trail near the Arbaney Kittle Trailhead ~12:24 PM, possibly breaking the tibia about a mile up; 14 MRA members mobilized 1:00 PM, reached the hiker 1:31 PM, carried to the trailhead 3:01 PM; transported to a local hospital for a severely injured left ankle.
location: Local trail ~1 mile above the Arbaney Kittle Trailhead
